name: wan-huiyan-overnight-workflows
description: Autonomous overnight workflows for client-facing delivery and insight discovery — multi-agent review panels baked in.

plugins.name: overnight-insight-discovery
plugins.description: Overnight autonomous B-vs-C parallel insight discovery that surfaces genuinely ah-ha findings from data, with a cohort-conditional novelty gate, an observational-analysis validity gate (composition / leak / anchor-timing / marker-vs-lever), adaptive tuning, and an agent-review-panel loop.

plugins.name: overnight-review-client-delivery
plugins.description: Overnight autonomous work session that produces a polished client delivery package by morning, with an 8-agent review panel to catch factual errors before they reach the client.

plugins.name: overnight-review-panel-blocked-reviewer-reads-as-clean
plugins.description: Companion safety pattern: in an unattended overnight review panel, a reviewer that couldn't see the code reads as a CLEAN one — usually because the code-review subagent lacks a Bash tool, so when told to `gh pr diff`/checkout a PR it returns a BLOCKED report (or reviews main, which predates the PR). Pre-generate per-base diffs + materialize worktrees + hand explicit paths, and treat BLOCKED as not-clean. Overnight specialization of the general skill code-reviewer-subagent-no-bash-blocked-on-pr-diff.

plugins.name: overnight-multi-issue-implementation
plugins.description: Overnight autonomous workflow that takes a cluster of related GitHub issues (typically a P1 review-panel finding set) and ships them to merged stacked PRs by morning. Builds on subagent-driven-development with overnight-specific discipline: stacked PRs (so PR2 doesn't wait on a human PR1-merge mid-night), pre-flight tracker-id audit (concurrent sessions on main steal IDs), final PR-level code review before proposing merge, review findings preserved as PR comments before squash. Sister to overnight-review-client-delivery and overnight-insight-discovery.

plugins.name: large-redesign-parallel-branch-collision-audit
plugins.description: Pre-flight audit before starting a large multi-PR redesign that rewrites shared files. Catches the failure mode where a long-running parallel feature branch (e.g. client-variant, staging, whitelabel) has unmerged commits touching the same files the redesign is about to rewrite — so they end up stranded with head-on conflicts that can't be cleanly cherry-picked. Sister to pre-merge-client-variant-regression-audit (audits a variant branch BEING merged into main; this audits BEFORE main diverges from a variant) and parallel-pr-scope-overlap-tiebreaker-delta-check (two simultaneous PRs vs. one redesign on main + WIP elsewhere). Companion to overnight-multi-issue-implementation for the file-collision dimension that the existing tracker-id audit doesn't cover.

plugins.name: subagent-review-tier-calibration-for-overnight-pr-chains
plugins.description: Calibrate review intensity per-PR (Tier 1 two-stage / Tier 2 combined single-agent / Tier 3 bash-only verification) when orchestrating a long chain (10+ PRs) of independent tasks overnight from a single implementation plan. Specializes subagent-driven-development's review step for throughput-tuned chains: prescribes three tiers, a decision rubric, and a concrete bash-verification recipe for low-risk visual-restyle PRs. Sister to subagent-driven-development (master pattern; this specializes the review step) and overnight-multi-issue-implementation (different shape: stacked PRs from issues vs. independent PRs from plan). Companion to large-redesign-parallel-branch-collision-audit (pre-flight before STARTING a chain).

plugins.name: plant-the-failure-before-you-trust-the-check
plugins.description: A check that has only ever passed has never been shown to work. Before trusting a guard, a test, an agent's "finding closed", or a cost fix, make the failure it exists to catch actually happen and confirm the check turns RED — and plant it in the production path, not the fixture (a fixture that already carries the field the code was meant to fetch keeps the test green after the fetch is deleted). Covers verifying a closed finding by running the negative case rather than grepping for the mechanism, measuring every factor of a cost before declaring it fixed, and putting a canary on the surface the leak actually uses. Companion safety pattern; adjacent to verifier-rederive-from-raw-not-the-checked-artifact, which hardens where a check gets its expected values, where this one asks whether the check can fail at all.

plugins.name: cross-lane-audit-quote-verbatim-and-pin-the-commit
plugins.description: Run two independent lanes that audit each other, hand each lane the other's words verbatim rather than your summary, and pin any commit under audit with `git update-ref refs/audit/<name> <sha>` so an amend or rebase cannot move it out from under the audit. Prevents the drift where the other lane specified something precisely and it was carried forward approximately — a blanket clock where an upper bound was granted, a path prefix where the rule named exact files, "before commit" where they wrote "before edit". No self-check catches these: the lane's own checks were built from its own restatement. Twenty-six such findings surfaced in one run, none by either lane's own checks. Companion safety pattern; sister to overnight-review-panel-blocked-reviewer-reads-as-clean and plant-the-failure-before-you-trust-the-check.

plugins.name: schedule-poll-orchestrator-pattern
plugins.description: Fire-ASAP orchestrator pattern for multi-track autonomous overnight workflows on scheduled triggers — a self-rescheduling poll loop that consolidates the moment all tracks report complete, and survives a 12-20h session end. Companion safety pattern.

plugins.name: observational-analysis-rigor
plugins.description: A validity toolkit for observational data analysis (no randomization): 32 skills covering leak-free point-in-time cohorts, composition/Simpson decomposition, event-anchor timing inversion, marker-vs-lever discipline, coverage-limited-join bias, provenance/re-derivation, and de-stale delivery to every rendered surface — the deep-dives behind overnight-insight-discovery's analytical validity gate.
